prompt_en: Wide full-body photograph in a cliffside astronomical natural-history observatory at blue hour. One clearly adult East Asian woman naturalist with facial appearance inspired by the attached reference wears an opaque high-neck cobalt canvas field suit, long sleeves, full-length trousers, gloves, and boots. She reclines sideways across a crescent basalt specimen bench while recording a living glass nautilus whose shell projects a rotating constellation into a shallow tide pool. Her left elbow is planted on a raised padded ledge, forearm upright, palm at temple; compressed sleeve fabric and a settled shoulder visibly show the elbow carrying her upper-body weight. From head through ribcage, waist, bent knees, and boots, her body follows one continuous C-shaped arc. Body-bounded negative space is unmistakable: her arm and torso contours enclose the opening. Continuous background visible through the opening is luminous tide-pool water. The intentional enclosed negative-space shape remains legible at thumbnail scale. The elbow-torso region remains identifiable. Eye-level framing from the open side shows both boots, every limb, the full bench, and elbow contact. Cool dome light and warm constellation reflections separate every contour.
